A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KnowSelf study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-J are readable and sufficiently complete for reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original KnowSelf experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop in Tables 2-3, alongside ablations, mechanism analyses, and appendix experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains the original ALFWorld and WebShop results, analytical experiments, and appendix comparisons.

M1.justification: The situation-classification criteria, knowledge selection, SFT-plus-RPO training, and special-token inference procedure remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices A-B. Prompt grammar corrections do not change the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ALFWorld household tasks and WebShop coverage, including the same cross-task ALFWorld generalization scenario. No dataset, domain, or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 2, 3, and 5 retain their respective baseline sets. Table 10 retains DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o, and Sentence-BERT. Newly cited related work is not added to the evaluated comparisons.

E3.justification: The ALFWorld 2,851/134 and WebShop 1,598/200 train/test counts remain unchanged in Tables 6-7. Metrics, model backbones, two-shot prompting, training settings, and decoding procedures also match.

E4.justification: Figures 3-5 retain the same ablations, generalization and scaling analyses, layer-wise probability analysis, and O1/R1 case studies. The prompting, training-stage, and retriever analyses in Appendices D, H, and I are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the benchmark results. The probability-averaging procedure in Appendix C and other statistical reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical results, plotted trends, and case-study outcomes match. For example, Llama-8B KnowSelf retains 84.33 on ALFWorld and 67.14 on WebShop in Tables 2-3; the appendix training-stage and retriever results also remain identical.

T1.justification: The POMDP formulation, formal situation criteria, and Equations 1-7 retain the same mathematical content. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about selective reflection and knowledge use, planning effectiveness, efficiency, and generalization. The novelty claim is also unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning planning-pattern overfitting, data scaling, late-layer decisions, and training stability remain unchanged. The limitations concerning task coverage, model scale, modality, and the proposed approach are retained.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware, knowledge-construction details and costs, reproduction instructions, and code-access information remain unchanged. Appendix J.1 contains grammatical edits without new technical instructions.

R1.justification: Section 6 and the bibliography add Chen's Large Knowledge Model: Perspectives and Challenges, Qian et al.'s SMART, and Wang et al.'s Self-DC. These modestly expand citation coverage without substantially revising the research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Acknowledgments section, corrects 're-producing' to 'reproducing,' and makes localized grammatical corrections in Appendix J.1. The substantive narrative and existing section order remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 5 and Tables 1-2 are enlarged, improving display legibility. Page flow and table placement shift, including Table 5 moving from page 15 to page 16. Display contents, captions, plotted data, and result highlighting remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Larger figures and table text improve legibility, the three added Section 6 references modestly improve related-work coverage, and Appendix J.1 receives grammatical corrections. These are limited presentation and contextual improvements; the methods, empirical evidence, claims, and limitations remain unchanged.
